verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships an official, documented MCP server (GitHub repo, developer docs, and support docs) that lets MCP-enabled clients like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code securely interact with a PagerDuty account (fetch/manage incidents, on-call info, etc.). This is first-party, clearly documented, and referenced across multiple sources including a dedicated developer docs page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
